transcript.text: panasonic nn h98 not heating anymore, any fix?

I can certainly help with that. Because this is a microwave, there are two main possibilities: either it is set to a low power mode (like Defrost or 50% power) which makes heating very slow, or there is an internal fault in the high-voltage circuitry. On Panasonic models like yours, if it runs but produces no heat at all on full power, the most common culprit is the inverter board (which controls power to the magnetron), followed by the magnetron itself. These are internal components that require a qualified engineer to replace safely due to high-voltage risks. Before we assume a part failure, please check:
1. Ensure it isn't set to Defrost or a low percentage setting.
2. Run a cup of water on Full Power for 60 seconds and tell me if the water gets hot.
